issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release v2.0.0 Section 4.4 empty collection propagation and Section 5.5.7 toQuantity([unit]) / convertsToQuantity([unit])
issues.evidence: EXPLORER probe .temp/qa/fp08_explorer_probe.py found forced Python fallback mismatch for empty optional unit arguments. Native C++ returned empty for 1.toQuantity({}) and 1.convertsToQuantity({}); fallback returned ["1 '1'"] / true. Spec says single-input functions passed an empty argument return empty, and FP-08 unit is an optional singleton String argument.
issues.root_cause: Forced Python fallback represents an explicitly empty singleton argument as [] from make_param(); misc.to_quantity() and misc.converts_to_quantity() treated falsey [] the same as an omitted optional unit argument.
issues.resolution: Preserve None as omitted unit and return empty when to_unit == [] for toQuantity([unit]) and convertsToQuantity([unit]) in the Python fallback.
